BrochureContent.Content:
Last remaining 3-bedroom duplex at Harbour Gate, Naas, Co. Kildare.

No. 11 Block C offers c. 120 sq.m of bright, contemporary living space, complete with two private terraces and a desirable south-facing aspect, providing plenty of natural light throughout the day.This exceptional home is ready for occupancy in the coming months, making it the perfect choice for those looking to move into a stylish new home in one of Naas' most sought-after developments.

This property is finished to an exceptionally high standard and comes complete with a fully fitted kitchen featuring integrated appliances, a washing machine, fitted wardrobes in all bedrooms, and fully tiled bathrooms with quality sanitary ware. 

Developed by the renowned Westar Group, Harbour Gate offers the perfect blend of quality, comfort and convenience, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, those looking to trade up, or anyone seeking a premium new home in a superb location.

Westar Group are delighted to introduce Harbour Gate. This new and exciting development will consist of contemporary 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartment and duplex homes located close to the heart of the thriving and popular commuter town of Naas, Co. Kildare. Naas has plenty to offer the prospective purchaser: a selection of top-rated schools locally coupled with excellent transport links, Naas is also well served with an array of shopping facilities, sports clubs, popular restaurants, bars, and gastro pubs.
Harbour Gate offers a perfect mix of rural tranquillity and modern convenience, it is located within minutes of the M7 and the Arrow Rail Link at Sallins, and Naas town centre is within a short 5-minute stroll along the Grand Canal.
3 bed duplex with c. 120 sq.m in size.

KITCHENS
Custom designed integrated Kitchen with quartz worktop.
Integrated cooking appliances and fridge/freezer providing contracts are signed and returned within 28 days of issue. 
Fan assisted ducted extractor vent from cooker hood to outside.
Stainless steel recessed sink.

UTILITY ROOM
Plumbed for washing machine and condensing dryer.

BATHROOMS & ENSUITES
Luxury contemporary tiles to bathroom floors and wall wet areas.
Pressurized shower system with rain head shower fittings, thermostatic mixer tap.
Wall mounted heated towel rails in all bathrooms.
High quality sanitary-ware throughout together with extra-large shower cubicle spaces.
Bathroom storage included in all main bathrooms and selected en-suites.

MEDIA & COMMUNICATIONS
Intercom / entry phone system from main block door in each apartment.
High speed fibre broadband connectivity.
Data (Cat6) / telephone points & digital TV connection 
points in a selection of living room and bedroom areas.
Main infrastructure installed to accommodate Eir, SIRO & Virgin Media.

HEATING, VENTILATION & HOT WATER
Thermostatic-zoned radiator central heating system in single floor apartment units by way of A-rated exhaust air heat pump. 
Central heating of two storey duplex units by way of thermostatically controlled radiators and A rated renewable air to water heat pump.
Pressurised hot & cold water systems.
Large cylinder for hot water storage.

ELECTRICAL
Generous number of power points throughout including a number with provision for USB charging.
A mix of pendant and recessed down lighter type light fittings.

INTERIOR FINISHES & FEATURES
 Contemporary feature architrave & skirting.
Satin finish chrome door furniture throughout.
Internal smooth finish painting throughout.
Superior quality internal joinery, including high quality timber doors.
Bespoke wardrobes by Akalim throughout all bedrooms as standard.
Interior designed entrance lobbies, lifts and common areas.

THE BUILDINGS & GARDENS
 Low u-value & Low-maintenance Alu-Clad windows by Nordan.
High acoustic performance floors and walls throughout.
Spacious balconies with glazed balustrades, and exterior light.
Landscape Architect designed private communal garden areas for residents.

SECURITY
Entry intercom phone system in each apartment connected to the main entrance door.
Secure access control and CCTV to entrance lobbies, covered car park and bicycle storage areas.
Wired for future intruder alarm system.
Mains-supply smoke detectors, heat detectors with battery back-up to apartments linked to landlord area fire detection alarm system.
Multi Point Locking System used on front door and patio door and windows.
• Warranty cover under HomeBond 10 year Structural and Latent Defect Insurance.

PARKING & SERVICES
3 beds will have two car parking spaces allocated.
Separate allocation of additional visitor parking.
Lift access from car park to all levels.
Secure cycle parking at car park level.
Centralized general and recycling waste disposal rooms at car park level.

ENERGY EFFICIENCY
A2 BER energy rating.
Highly insulated air tight design.
Low Energy windows, Argon filled with low emissivity coating to reflect heat back into rooms.
High performance internal pipe insulation to reduce heat loss.
Energy saving LED light fittings in selected living spaces & building common areas.
Provision for electric car-charging points.
